scope: Real SSR SDK, auth actions, guards, proxy and callback routes with simulated Supabase HTTP and cookies; not hosted Supabase.
checks: Unauthenticated account redirects to login
Password login persists production cookies and safe next destination
New server request reads login cookies and grants account access
Authenticated customer still cannot access admin
Profile failure is not disguised as a logged-out session
Auth service outage does not become a login redirect
External next destination is rejected
Browser SSR client sees the server-issued session
Browser password sign-in is persisted for a new server request
Dedicated logout succeeds without Redis: healthy
Dedicated logout succeeds without Redis: timeout
Dedicated logout succeeds without Redis: unavailable
Dedicated logout succeeds without Redis: invalid
Dedicated logout succeeds without Redis: missing
Logout rejects invalid Origin without signing out
Logout rejects missing Origin without signing out
Logout rejects null Origin without signing out
Logout rejects malformed Origin without signing out
Logout rejects cross-site without signing out
Login remains fail-closed for Redis timeout, unavailable and invalid response
Sensitive pages preserve same-origin form Origin without cross-origin referrers
Proxy refresh forwards rotated cookies to browser and downstream server
Registration uses configured production callback and stores PKCE verifier
Email PKCE exchange writes session before account redirect
Email token-hash confirmation persists session
Password recovery uses production URL
Recovery confirmation redirects to password reset
Password update clears cookies and reloads login
Logout clears persisted session after a new login
Invalid confirmation link cannot create session
